import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

DATASET_PATH = 'chunks_csv/bivariate/bivariate_2023_energy_waste.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(DATASET_PATH)
adj = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)

boroughs = sorted(df['borough'].unique())
n = len(boroughs)
borough_index = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(boroughs)}

# Build W
A = np.zeros((n, n), dtype=int)
for _, row in adj.iterrows():
    i = borough_index.get(row['borough'])
    j = borough_index.get(row['neighbor'])
    if i is not None and j is not None:

        A[j, i] = 1
np.fill_diagonal(A, 0)
degrees = A.sum(axis=1)
W = np.zeros((n, n))
for i in range(n):
    if degrees[i] > 0:
        W[i, :] = A[i, :] / degrees[i]

# Extract x (Energy) and y (Waste) in order
df_sorted = df.set_index('borough').loc[boroughs]

y = df_sorted['Waste_value'].values

# Method 1: z-scores

zy = (y - y.mean()) / y.std(ddof=0)

print('Lee L (z-score method):', L_z)

# Method 2: mean-centered only
xc = x - x.mean()
yc = y - y.mean()
S0 = W.sum()
L_mc = (n / S0) * (xc @ (W @ yc)) / np.sqrt((xc @ xc) * (yc @ yc))
print('Lee L (mean-centered method):', L_mc)

# Permutation test: shuffle y (Waste) 500 times

perms = 500
L_perms = np.empty(perms)
for p in range(perms):

    zy_perm = (y_perm - y_perm.mean()) / y_perm.std(ddof=0)
    L_perms[p] = (zx @ (W @ zy_perm)) / n

# Two-tailed p-value
obs = L_z
extreme_count = np.sum(np.abs(L_perms) >= np.abs(obs))
p_val = (extreme_count + 1) / (perms + 1)
print('Observed L:', obs)
print('Permutation mean:', L_perms.mean())
print('Permutation std:', L_perms.std())
print('Extreme count:', extreme_count)
